nuances.title: Continuous aspect: gerund vs 'estar a + infinitive'
nuances.ai_likely_does: Produces European 'estou a tentar', 'estou a verificar', 'estás a falar'.
nuances.native_does: Uses gerund: 'tô tentando', 'tô verificando', 'tá falando' (I'm trying / checking / you're speaking).

nuances.title: Clitic placement: proclisis not enclisis
nuances.native_does: Proclisis in speech: 'me ajuda', 'pode me dizer', 'meu nome é João' / 'me chamo João'.

nuances.title: Address pronoun: 'você' default, never EP 'tu' conjugation
nuances.ai_likely_does: Mixes in 'tu' with European 2nd-person verb forms ('tu podes', 'tens') or over-formal 'vós'.
nuances.native_does: 'você' as default ('você pode', 'você tem') and 'o senhor/a senhora' for deference with 3rd-person verb; if 'tu' appears (regional), still 3rd-person verb 'tu pode'.

nuances.title: Phone number grouping and 'meia' for six
nuances.ai_likely_does: Reads digits one-by-one in English-style triples, says 'seis' always.
nuances.native_does: Groups as DDD + pairs, uses 'meia' (=meia dúzia) for 6 in strings: 'onze, nove-nove-um-dois, três-meia-quatro-cinco'.

nuances.title: Email/URL verbalization: arroba, ponto
nuances.ai_likely_does: Says 'at' / 'dot', or literal 'a comercial', spells host letter-by-letter awkwardly.
nuances.native_does: '@' = 'arroba', '.' = 'ponto', '_' = 'underline'/'sublinhado', '-' = 'traço' or 'hífen'; e.g. 'joao ponto silva arroba gmail ponto com'.

nuances.title: Calques for travel/telecom terms
nuances.ai_likely_does: Calques or uses awkward terms for rebooking/connection/refund.
nuances.native_does: Native domain words: 'remarcar' (rebook), 'voo de conexão/escala', 'cartão de embarque', 'bagagem despachada', 'reembolso' (refund), 'fatura' (bill), 'franquia de dados'.

nuances.title: 'celular' / 'ônibus' / 'trem' not EP lexicon
nuances.ai_likely_does: Uses European lexicon: 'telemóvel', 'autocarro', 'comboio', 'apelido' (for surname), 'casa de banho'.

nuances.title: Native hesitation markers
nuances.ai_likely_does: Uses English-ish 'uh/um', or no fillers; overly clean sentences.
nuances.native_does: 'é...', 'né?', 'então', 'tipo', 'sei lá', 'deixa eu ver', 'peraí' (hold on); confirms with 'tá' / 'tá bom' / 'beleza'.

nuances.title: Phone backchannels and 'oi?/alô'
nuances.ai_likely_does: Answers/opens with 'olá' formally, uses 'sim sim' robotically, English 'hello'.
nuances.native_does: Phone greeting 'Alô?'; attention 'Oi?'; backchannels 'uhum', 'sei', 'aham', 'certo', 'tá', 'entendi' while listening.

nuances.title: Service-call politeness routines
nuances.ai_likely_does: Over-literal 'eu gostaria de', 'por favor' stacked, English 'desculpe-me incomodar'.
nuances.native_does: 'queria' / 'eu queria' (softer than gostaria), 'será que dá pra...', 'por gentileza', 'imagina/de nada' for 'you're welcome', 'tô ligando por causa de...'.

nuances.title: Adjective/article agreement with nouns
nuances.ai_likely_does: Mismatches gender, esp. with 'a gente': 'o reserva', 'meu passagem', 'a problema', 'a gente vamos'.
nuances.native_does: 'a reserva', 'minha passagem', 'o problema', 'a gente vai' (3rd-sg); 'a tarifa', 'o voo', 'a fatura'.

nuances.title: Dates as 'dia X de mês', primeiro for 1st
nuances.ai_likely_does: Says 'mês/dia' in English order or 'X de mês de ano' stiffly; uses 'um de janeiro'.
nuances.native_does: 'dia quinze de março', 'no dia 3', first of month = 'primeiro de janeiro' (not 'um'); year 'dois mil e vinte e seis'.

nuances.title: Money: reais e centavos
nuances.ai_likely_does: Says 'R$ 50.00' as 'cinquenta pontos zero zero' or 'cinquenta dólares', uses comma/dot wrong.
nuances.native_does: 'cinquenta reais', 'cinquenta reais e noventa centavos', 'mil e duzentos reais'; decimal is comma.

nuances.title: Alphanumeric codes: letter naming and grouping
nuances.ai_likely_does: Spells letters with English names (J='jay', H='aitch', W='double-u').
nuances.native_does: Portuguese letter names: J='jota', H='agá', W='dáblio', Y='ípsilon', K='cá', Z='zê'; phonetic clarifiers 'A de amor'.

nuances.title: Translationese for 'I need/want to' and 'help'
nuances.ai_likely_does: Literal 'Eu preciso de ajuda com', 'Eu tenho um problema com'.
nuances.native_does: 'Preciso resolver...', 'Tô com um problema...', 'Tô precisando...', 'Você consegue ver pra mim?'.

nuances.title: 'Tudo bem?' opener and confirm-by-question intonation
nuances.ai_likely_does: Skips greeting smalltalk; flat statements where a rising 'né?' is expected.
nuances.native_does: Opens 'Oi, tudo bem?'; tag 'né?' (rising) seeks agreement; rising 'tá?' = checking question vs falling 'tá' = agreement — intonation flips meaning.

nuances.title: Number gender agreement (dois/duas)
nuances.ai_likely_does: Invariant 'dois' regardless of noun gender: 'dois passagens', 'duzentos malas'.

nuances.title: Asking for repetition / clarification
nuances.native_does: 'Como?', 'Oi?', 'Não entendi', 'Pode falar de novo?', 'Como assim?', 'Repete pra mim?'.
